claims.statement: Zoom Platform Studio lets a developer create an API key for Build platform APIs and webhooks; the key is displayed once at creation and cannot be shown again, and a JWT is generated from the account API key and secret.

sources.supports: Create your API Key to access Build platform APIs and webhooks.
This is your new API key. Make sure to copy it before closing this dialog. For security reasons, it will not be shown again.
The JWT is created from your account API key and secret.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Not researched beyond existence: prefix, alphabet, length and any checksum are not stated on the pages read, and no value shape may be inferred from the examples (docs examples are placeholders or illustrative).

The page speaks of an API key and secret; whether the secret is a second credential string, and how the Build-platform JWT relates to Meeting SDK and Video SDK JWTs (documented on other pages not read in this run), is not settled.
